section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: It may be seen that deaths due to acts of nature account for 30.2% and those due to other causes constitute the remaining 69.8% of the total accidental deaths in the country. As observed in previous years also, drowning accounted for a very large number of deaths (27,915) and constituted 20% of the total. Road accidents and accidents on the railways accounted for 7,288 and 8,282 deaths respectively. The pattern of the percentage distribution of accidental deaths due to various causes has been more or less the same as in the past five years, except for accidents on the roads and deaths due to poisoning.
